newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's Renel in $150 mln corporate bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Romania's Renel in $150 mln corporate bond issue.

text.p: Romania's Renel RA electricity authority has raised $150 million through a corporate bond issue launched through Merrill Lynch International, Renel's president said on Tuesday.
Victor Romert told Bucharest television the state-run utility would use the funds to finance part of its gas and fuel oil imports and to upgrade power plants.

The placement had enjoyed interest from European, Asian and U.S. investors, Romert said, adding that $135 million would come from investors in Europe and the United States and the remainder from Japan and south-east Asia.
The bonds have a maturity of five years in Europe and the United States. Those in Asia mature within three years.
No other terms of the issue were available.
In December, Renel signed a $160 million syndicated loan, the first corporate raising by a Romanian company on the international markets, also for fuel imports.
That loan was arranged by ING Bank with Bank of America NT&SA, BHF-Bank Aktiengesellschaft, Societe Generale and Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi as co-arrangers.
